text: MCP stands for Model Context Protocol — it's an open standard that lets AI models like me talk to external tools and data sources through a consistent interface. An MCP server is a lightweight process that exposes capabilities — things like reading files, querying a database, or calling an API — as named tools that the AI can invoke. The model just calls the tool by name with arguments, the MCP server handles the actual execution, and the result comes back. It's basically a plug-in system for AI, so you can wire up any service without rebuilding the integration each time.
